event.findings: Reproduced the parser defect: nullish-coalescing a top-level empty usage object suppressed valid nested response.usage. The request log now observes each allowlisted source and reports bounded reported/partial/missing/invalid status, required-field gaps, invalid field names, and source paths; no raw values or response body are stored.
event.limitations: The historical request's raw SSE was not retained, so whether that exact event carried both empty top-level and valid nested usage cannot be retroactively proven. No real provider calls or live Desktop deployment were performed. PR #16 remains open and conflicting; this task is based on current master.

event.observation: One full Runtime run executed concurrently with the full Desktop suite timed out in an existing waitForUsage helper (530/531). The failing test passed alone, and the full Runtime suite passed 531/531 when rerun serially; no source change was made for this transient contention.
event.review: Independent read-only review found stale-value and cache-total inconsistencies; they were corrected with regression tests. Follow-up review confirmed the findings resolved and no actionable issue remains. One rare malformed-source ordering observation was assessed as non-blocking and left unchanged.
event.limitations: Historical raw SSE remains unavailable; exact old request payload cannot be reconstructed. No real provider calls, deployment, merge, release or main-worktree synchronization were performed.
